fire: Long ago a blind weaver lived in a cottage at the edge of the marsh.
She feared that her brother was in serious trouble with the law.

Seals were slaughtered for their oil all along that coast.
I never told the people in my building what had happened.
By then the old captain had been dead for nearly a year.
